texts: mixed: the rule fires and no content is lost, but the deposited threads were filed under the role for objects the action changes rather than the role for things merely put somewhere, so a question about what the moth leaves behind may fail to match. 'Leave' is also ambiguous between departing and depositing, so write 'When a nightmoth lands on a lantern, the nightmoth deposits silken threads on the lantern.' Separately, this sentence's parse spells the creature night_moth while your other two sentences spell it nightmoth, so facts about it will not join up - that one is ours to fix, not yours.
good. 'is resting' gives the resting an anchor of its own, and the shedding is tied to each resting occasion with the threads and the destination lantern both in place.
good. 'Every silken thread' becomes a fireable rule that gives each thread its own source underside on its own nightmoth, with 'every' recorded as the quantifier word.
